evidence.detail: Core behavior and architecture contracts are documented.
All behavior is classified into deterministic test tiers.
The complete current deterministic gate passed 733 tests across all six tiers.
No production workload correctness observations exist.

deficiencies: No production workload, SLO, or field-correctness evidence exists.
dimensions.recommendation: Define supported deployment objectives and collect production correctness indicators before release.

evidence.detail: Threat categories, least privilege, secret handling, and blocking rules are documented.
The security tier covers permissions, privacy, safe mode, plugins, tools, prompt injection, and generated skills.
No independent penetration test or hardened network deployment rehearsal exists.
No production security monitoring or incident evidence exists.

deficiencies: The API is loopback-first and lacks a verified hardened network deployment profile.
No independent security assessment has been retained.
dimensions.recommendation: Complete network authentication, TLS, origin controls, resource limits, and an independent security assessment.

evidence.detail: Failure recovery, checkpoints, resource limits, and interruption behavior are specified.
Deterministic chaos and regression suites cover database, provider, tool, memory, skill, transaction, and agent faults.
No long-running soak, concurrency, or restart rehearsal exists for a supported deployment.
No production availability or error-rate SLI exists.

deficiencies: No defined reliability SLO, soak test, or sustained concurrency evidence exists.
dimensions.recommendation: Define SLIs and SLOs, then run bounded restart, concurrency, and soak rehearsals.

evidence.detail: Content-minimized telemetry, audit, dashboards, and decision explainability are specified.
Telemetry, dashboard, audit, profiler, and explainability behavior has deterministic coverage.
The live local database exposes task, model, memory, token, and waste summaries.
No deployed trace, metric, log correlation, alerting, or retention evidence exists.

deficiencies: No production signal export, alert policy, SLI dashboard, or on-call response evidence exists.
dimensions.recommendation: Define supported signals and alerts for the deployment profile and validate end-to-end incident diagnosis.

evidence.detail: Performance review requires repeated paired reductions with quality and security gates.
Profiler, benchmark, token economy, cost, and waste components have deterministic tests.
No representative end-to-end load benchmark or capacity envelope exists.
No production latency, throughput, saturation, or resource profile exists.

deficiencies: Representative workload baselines, capacity limits, and performance SLOs are unavailable.
dimensions.recommendation: Benchmark supported task classes under realistic concurrency and publish bounded capacity limits.

evidence.detail: Backup scope, secret exclusion, manifest integrity, and staged restore are specified.
Create, verify, corruption rejection, compatibility, and restore behavior have deterministic tests.
A schema-63 archive with 19 entries was created, hash verified, integrity checked, and restored to a fresh target.
No scheduled production backup, off-device retention, restore drill, RPO, or RTO evidence exists.

deficiencies: No production backup schedule, independent storage, retention policy, RPO, or RTO has been verified.
dimensions.recommendation: Define RPO and RTO, automate protected backups, and retain periodic restore-drill evidence.

evidence.detail: Forward-only schema migration, backup, compatibility, and rollback-on-failure behavior are specified.
Every schema generation and injected migration failure has deterministic coverage.
The live database passed quick_check, FTS5, and schema 63 of 63 validation.
No released-version production upgrade history exists.

deficiencies: No immutable prior release has been upgraded with production-scale data and retained timing evidence.
dimensions.recommendation: Build the prior release artifact and rehearse an upgrade on representative copied data before tagging.

evidence.detail: Rollback responsibilities and the distinction between database restore and version rollback are specified.
Transaction, skill, policy, override, migration-failure, and regression rollback paths have deterministic tests.
No full application release rollback from a deployed candidate to an immutable prior release has been rehearsed.
No production rollback timing or recovery evidence exists.

deficiencies: There is no immutable prior application release or end-to-end deployment rollback rehearsal.
dimensions.recommendation: Create immutable release artifacts and rehearse version rollback plus database restore as separate procedures.

evidence.detail: Sensitivity, provider/export policy, retention, erasure, and audit behavior are specified.
Classification, export denial, retention, erasure verification, and audit behavior have deterministic tests.
No deployment-specific data inventory, privacy impact assessment, or operator erasure drill exists.
No production retention, access, deletion, or disclosure metrics exist.

deficiencies: The supported data inventory, legal basis, privacy impact assessment, and operational deletion drill are unavailable.
dimensions.recommendation: Define the deployment data inventory and privacy obligations, then rehearse access and deletion workflows.

evidence.detail: Local provider contracts, timeouts, capability checks, and failure recording are specified.
Unavailable, timeout, malformed, and uncertain provider outcomes have deterministic and chaos coverage.
The current live smoke test proves success but not an operator-observed outage and recovery drill.
No production provider availability, retry, or fallback metrics exist.

deficiencies: No live provider outage, restart, timeout, and recovery rehearsal has been retained.
dimensions.recommendation: Run a bounded local-provider outage drill and verify task state, held resources, recovery, and operator diagnostics.

evidence.detail: The architecture explicitly requires rate limits before LAN access.
No API rate limiter, quota policy, 429 contract, or deterministic rate-limit test exists.
No request-flood or quota-exhaustion rehearsal exists.
No production request-rate, rejection, saturation, or abuse evidence exists.

deficiencies: Network API interaction frequency is not limited.
No per-client quota, 429 response, burst policy, or rate-limit telemetry exists.
dimensions.recommendation: Implement bounded per-principal and fallback per-address rate limiting before any non-loopback deployment.

evidence.detail: Task budgets, immutable price catalogs, usage accounting, and partial/unpriced states are specified.
Atomic reservations, hard limits, price revisions, usage meters, and rollback behavior have deterministic tests.
No paid provider is configured and no billing reconciliation rehearsal exists.
No production spend, budget rejection, or billing variance evidence exists.

deficiencies: Paid-provider price coverage, billing reconciliation, alerts, and operational budget policy are unavailable.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep paid providers disabled until prices, hard budgets, reconciliation, and alerts are verified.

evidence.detail: Typed narrowing overrides, audit, expiry, revocation, and verified rollback controls are specified.
Override scope, conflicts, enforcement, safe mode, revocation, and rollback behavior have deterministic tests.
No operator incident exercise has rehearsed override, safe mode, rollback, and recovery together.
No production override response-time or audit-review evidence exists.

deficiencies: No named operator runbook or end-to-end containment and recovery drill exists.
dimensions.recommendation: Assign operator roles and rehearse safe mode, override, rollback, and revocation with retained audit evidence.

evidence.detail: Architecture, API, CLI, skill, schema, provider, and troubleshooting references have defined source derivations.
Proposal freshness, exact review hashes, stale-source rejection, and publication gates have deterministic tests.
Generated references were proposed, reviewed, published, and rechecked unchanged at the current source digest.
No released versioned documentation site, operator feedback, or support evidence exists.

deficiencies: Documentation is repository-local and not bound to an immutable published release.
dimensions.recommendation: Publish version-bound documentation with the first immutable release and verify install and recovery procedures from it.
